digest.component_or_area: test suite — Jira adapter (DC transport, pagination, rate limit, backend registry)
propositions: Five tests with vacuous assertions or incomplete implementations pass when they should fail, masking real contract violations and carrying docstring promises they never check
test_the_pat_never_appears_in_the_repr_of_the_transport does not receive a PAT in its constructor and cannot fail to detect a PAT in repr because no repr is defined

test_the_structural_guard_fires_on_a_synthetic_unpaginated_caller re-implements the AST walk inline instead of calling the shared predicate it claims to test, so regressions in the real predicate go undetected
_search_issues_calls_taking_the_default hardcodes the live transport source and cannot be redirected to test synthetic unpaginated source without parameterization
test_validate_assignee_exists_returns_the_dc_username asserts only that the method exists (already covered by parametrized presence test), not its return-value contract of a username string

test_every_mutating_transport_member_still_fails_on_the_first_429 uses total <= 1 which is satisfied by zero client calls (pre-flight failures never reaching the 429 path) and blanket pytest.raises(Exception) that does not pin the expected BackendHTTPError with .code == 429
